changes.text: Rebuilt sync engine — the app is instant from the very first frame.
Delta sync: only changed records are transferred, not the full dataset.
Background sync keeps data current without blocking the UI.
Update log: see what changed in each version under Settings.

blocks.text: Open the app, and you're there. No loading screen, no spinner, no waiting for data to trickle in. The new sync engine keeps everything current in the background — so what you see is always real, always yours.

The previous architecture fetched your full dataset on every launch. The new engine works differently: it keeps a local snapshot and only ever transfers what actually changed — a delta. Less data. Less waiting. Same result.

rows: Show local data instantly, sync in background
Only records that changed since last sync
Full read + write, syncs when back online

blocks.text: No connection? No problem. MedTracker now reads and writes entirely from a local store. When your connection returns, changes sync automatically — in the correct order, with no duplicates.
Your data is always safe. Every write is committed locally first before it reaches the network. Nothing is ever lost.
This release also introduces the Update Log — the screen you're reading right now. Every future update will appear here with full release notes, directly from GitHub, without a new app install.
